title: Evaluating Open-Source Sparse Autoencoders on Disentangling Factual Knowledge in GPT-2 Small
reasoning: The paper focuses on mechanistic interpretability and the evaluation of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to disentangle factual geographical knowledge (cities, countries, and continents) within GPT-2 Small. It does not evaluate or benchmark aspects of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
